**Finding submitted: T4C — missing (high severity).**

- **Investigated:** §9.1–9.5 (breach, insolvency, Customer cause-based Order Form termination, cross-Order Form effect), §8.1–8.3 (three-year term, 180-day non-renewal, uplift cap), §10.1–10.2 (effect/refunds), §27.3 (force majeure exit), plus §§6.2, 19.4, 20.5, 24.4 remedy-specific termination rights.
- **Conclusion:** No convenience termination right exists for Customer anywhere in a three-year term — walk-away territory, so fallback is not met. Vendor also has no convenience right, but nothing quotable confirms it, so the insert states it expressly. §8.2's non-renewal mechanic is a RENEWAL term and was deliberately not double-flagged.
- **Cure:** One insert filling the §9.4 numbering gap — Customer convenience termination of the Agreement or any Order Form on 30 days' notice, pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, and no Vendor convenience right during a committed term. Fallback (60–90 days plus a three-month fee cap) offered in the comment.
